prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a preschool listening picture-card game
Primary request: create one polished wide 3:2 illustration sheet containing exactly six isolated animal picture-card subjects in this exact left-to-right row order.
Scene/backdrop: one uniform warm pale cream background across the whole sheet, with broad empty gutters separating every cell.
Subject: top row, left to right: one friendly cat; one friendly dog; one friendly bird. Bottom row, left to right: one friendly fish; one friendly duck; one friendly frog.
Style/medium: consistent flat picture-book illustration for young children; simple rounded shapes; clean solid color fills; subtle paper-like softness; strong smooth navy outlines of equal visual weight.
Composition/framing: rigid 3-column by 2-row grid on a wide 3:2 canvas; six equal cells; each subject fully contained, isolated, centered, similarly scaled, and surrounded by generous breathing room; clear empty separation and outer margins; no subject crosses a cell boundary.
Lighting/mood: bright, gentle, cheerful, calm, non-frightening.
Constraints: exactly one named animal per cell and exactly six subjects total; preserve the exact ordering; no words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, divider text, logos, signatures, or watermark; no people; no hands holding anything; no scenes, habitats, ground lines, cages, bowls, branches, water, plants, props, accessories, or extra objects; no cell borders that touch a subject.
Avoid: ambiguity between animals; duplicate animals; extra body parts; cropped subjects; adjacent-cell leakage; photorealism; 3D rendering; clutter; artifacts; frightening expressions.
